Name: Crater

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Chooses the noise that breaks up crater rims, floors, and the terrain around each crater.

Params.Name: NoiseScale
Params.Label: Noise Scale
Params.Description: Sets the size of the breakup around crater rims and across crater floors.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values pack more variation around each crater.

Params.Name: NoiseSeed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Rearranges crater rim and floor variation without changing crater placement.
Params.Tooltip: Use a new seed for a different crater surface pattern.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Bends the crater breakup field so rims and floors do not repeat evenly.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it for more irregular crater shapes and surfaces.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Offsets cellular feature points in crater surface breakup.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; crater placement is unchanged.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the overall height amplitude of the generated shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the overall strength of this base shape.

Params.Name: Rotation
Params.Description: Rotates the shape's sampling coordinates around the terrain center.
Params.Tooltip: Use rotation to change the direction of directional features.

Params.Name: Position
Params.Description: Controls the normalized location of the primary feature.
Params.Tooltip: Move the feature within the terrain using its normalized coordinates.

Params.Name: Radius
Params.Description: Controls the size of the primary radial feature.
Params.Tooltip: Increase radius to affect a larger area.

Params.Name: Depth
Params.Description: Controls how deeply the generated feature cuts into the terrain.
Params.Tooltip: Increase depth for a stronger depression or relief.

Params.Name: InnerFalloff
Params.Label: Inner Falloff
Params.Description: Controls the inner falloff value used by the Crater base shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust inner falloff to change the generated terrain.

Params.Name: Height
Params.Description: Controls the vertical height of the generated feature.

Params.Name: OuterFalloff
Params.Label: Outer Falloff
Params.Description: Controls the outer falloff value used by the Crater base shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust outer falloff to change the generated terrain.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: LargeDistortion
Params.Label: Large Distortion
Params.Description: Controls the amount of broad-scale distortion.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value for larger irregular shape changes.

Params.Name: SmallDistortion
Params.Label: Small Distortion
Params.Description: Controls the amount of fine-scale distortion.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value for more detailed irregularity.

Params.Name: LargeNoise
Params.Label: Large Noise
Params.Description: Controls broad noise variation in the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value for stronger large-scale noise.

Params.Name: SmallNoise
Params.Label: Small Noise
Params.Description: Controls fine noise variation in the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value for stronger small-scale noise.

Params.Name: InsideNoise
Params.Label: Inside Noise
Params.Description: Controls noise applied inside the primary feature.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value to make the interior more varied.

Params.Name: OutsideNoise
Params.Label: Outside Noise
Params.Description: Controls noise applied outside the primary feature.
Params.Tooltip: Increase this value to add more surrounding terrain variation.

Description: Generates a crater-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
